answer: Before I go deep on gear — is the all-day-in-open-sun thing still current? Back in January you mentioned you'd been spending most of your daytime hours in the interior stacks at the library with your eyes adapted to that steady low indoor light, so the "consistently bright sun" setup is from last summer. If you are back outside for long stretches, the high-value basics are wraparound UV400 polarized sunglasses, a wide-brimmed hat so light reaches your eyes indirectly, and scheduled shade/water breaks — tell me what you're doing out there and I'll tailor the picks.
